title: Motion Menu
note: One line per item. Numbers (no) are assigned once by tools/catalog.py and never change, so 'keep 7' always means the same thing. Rename freely: only name and label change. New items get the next free number.

groups.name: Scene changes
groups.blurb: How one scene hands over to the next.

groups.name: Type moves
groups.blurb: Ways for words and letters to arrive.

groups.name: Shapes
groups.blurb: Dots, tiles and plates that move in time.

groups.name: Weight and bounce
groups.blurb: Small bits of physics that make things feel real.

groups.name: Depth
groups.blurb: 3D objects, scan lines and camera moves.

groups.name: Particles
groups.blurb: Thousands of points acting as one.

groups.name: Screens and graphs
groups.blurb: Cards, charts and controls that move like a real app.

groups.name: Camera and finish
groups.blurb: What every frame gets on top. Shown split: effect off on the left, on on the right.

groups.name: Numbers and words
groups.blurb: Counting numbers, ranges, and words that land the moment they are said.

groups.name: Marks and diagrams
groups.blurb: Highlights, arrows, measuring lines, callouts, chains of ideas and a chapter rail.

groups.name: Court and distances
groups.blurb: A court drawn to scale, with distances, routes, turns and foot contacts.

groups.name: Athlete and force
groups.blurb: A simple athlete in its poses, and the forces acting on it.

groups.name: Force and time
groups.blurb: Force-time curves and the rate of force development.

groups.name: Anatomy
groups.blurb: The app's own body drawing, lit muscle by muscle.

groups.name: Camera moves
groups.blurb: Push in, pull out, drift and return on one static shot. Shown on a stand-in picture, not real footage.

groups.name: Metaphors
groups.blurb: One picture for one hard idea. Use at most one per video, after the real mechanism has been shown.

groups.name: Frame furniture
groups.blurb: The small graphic details that frame the picture.

groups.name: Looks
groups.blurb: Colour sets, each one a mood the reel already used.

groups.name: Type pairs
groups.blurb: Fonts that work together, with where each was used.

groups.name: Feel
groups.blurb: Easing curves and timing, with the name to call them by.

groups.name: House rules
groups.blurb: How picture and sound stay locked together.

groups.name: Drums
groups.blurb: The pulse.

groups.name: Low end
groups.blurb: Bass and sub.

groups.name: Chords and pads
groups.blurb: Harmony: soft beds and sharp hits.

groups.name: Notes and bells
groups.blurb: Single notes, runs and bells.

groups.name: Sweeps and builds
groups.blurb: Moving noise and tone that carries a transition.

groups.name: Hits and explosions
groups.blurb: The big moments.

groups.name: Clicks and glitches
groups.blurb: Small, sharp, digital.

groups.name: Sport
groups.blurb: The sounds of the court and the gym.

groups.name: Alerts
groups.blurb: Small signals for things that appear.

groups.name: Mix tricks
groups.blurb: Devices that make everything else hit harder.

items.name: Full Stop
items.label: The dot swells and floods the screen.

items.name: Slab
items.label: A black bar sweeps across carrying the next number.
takes: the number or word on the bar

items.name: Portal
items.label: A circle opens like an eye into the next scene.

items.name: Static
items.label: A glitch cut on a white flash.

items.name: Clamshell
items.label: The screen splits open from the middle.

items.name: Whiplash
items.label: A fast whip of the camera with heavy blur.

items.name: Strobe
items.label: A hard cut on a white flash.

items.name: Venetian
items.label: Vertical blinds sweep the next scene in.

items.name: Pinhole
items.label: A circle grows from the centre and shows the next scene.

items.name: Shatter
items.label: Strips of the picture slide sideways, then settle.

items.name: Tunnel
items.label: Zoom through the old scene into the new one.

items.name: Mosaic
items.label: The picture breaks into big pixels and back.

items.name: Flipcard
items.label: The scene turns over like a card.

items.name: Rise
items.label: Words rise out from behind a line.

items.name: Tumble
items.label: Letters drop in with a spin and one bounce.

items.name: Pop
items.label: A short word pops in with a springy overshoot.

items.name: Swing
items.label: A serif letter swings in with a tilt.

items.name: Heavyweight
items.label: A word grows from thin to black as it slides in.

items.name: Monolith
items.label: A word gets a 3D block on the beat.

items.name: Punch In
items.label: Letters slam in from the camera.

items.name: Thud
items.label: A letter drops, lands and bounces once.

items.name: Bullseye
items.label: Rings of dots pop in from the centre.

items.name: Quarter Turn
items.label: Dots turn into a pattern of quarter circles.

items.name: Pills
items.label: Tiles merge into bars that slide against each other.

items.name: Gravity
items.label: Everything collapses into one disc.

items.name: Dot Pop
items.label: A dot pops in with a shock ring.

items.name: Slash
items.label: A thick line draws itself across the screen.

items.name: Ripple
items.label: A ring expands while its edge gets thinner.

items.name: Twist
items.label: Nested squares turn a quarter turn.

items.name: Tip Over
items.label: A triangle flips over with an overshoot.

items.name: Spinner
items.label: A cross grows its arms while it spins.

items.name: Sweep
items.label: A thick arc sweeps around and keeps spinning.

items.name: Pinpoint
items.label: A big dot shrinks to a point and rises.

items.name: Squash
items.label: A ball stretches in the air and squashes when it lands.

items.name: Tremor
items.label: A flat ring ripples out along the floor from a landing.

items.name: Dust
items.label: Little specks kick up where a letter lands.

items.name: Ruler
items.label: A line shoots out and prints its tick marks and numbers.

items.name: Heartbeat
items.label: A dot pulses with a ring, like a pulse.

items.name: Hop
items.label: The ball hops across the word and lands as the full stop.

items.name: Afterglow
items.label: A landing sends out a ring and a warm glow.

items.name: Spring Lab
items.label: A ball on a rail, sprung with real numbers.

items.name: Trefoil
items.label: A glossy 3D knot that draws itself along its path.

items.name: Spin Kick
items.label: A beat kicks the spin faster.

items.name: X-Ray
items.label: A scan line turns solid into wireframe.

items.name: Dive
items.label: The camera flies through the object.

items.name: Orbit
items.label: A ring with three glowing satellites circles the object.

items.name: Ghost Word
items.label: A giant outlined word sits behind the 3D object.

items.name: Big Bang
items.label: Thousands of points burst out of the centre.

items.name: Current
items.label: Points ride a flow field and leave trails of light.

items.name: Assembly
items.label: Points rush in and lock into a word.

items.name: Supernova
items.label: The word blows apart.

items.name: Bento
items.label: Cards spring in one after another.

items.name: Pulse Line
items.label: A chart draws itself, then a tooltip pops.

items.name: Ring Counter
items.label: A donut that counts up to a number.

items.name: Switch
items.label: A toggle flips with a spring.

items.name: Scrub
items.label: A slider drags and its number follows.

items.name: Skyline
items.label: Bars grow with a spring and the last one lights up.

items.name: Odometer
items.label: A big number counts up next to a live dot.

items.name: Lifeline
items.label: A heartbeat line scrolls under a number.

items.name: Tick List
items.label: Checks draw themselves one by one.

items.name: Pointer
items.label: A cursor moves, presses and sends out a ripple.

items.name: Curve Lab
items.label: An easing curve editor with live handles.

items.name: Keyframes
items.label: Diamonds pop onto a timeline, one per move.

items.name: Shutter
items.label: Real motion blur: every frame is many snapshots blended.

items.name: Jolt
items.label: Hits shake and punch the camera.

items.name: Halo
items.label: Bright things glow softly.

items.name: Prism
items.label: Colour fringes split off on every hit.

items.name: Film
items.label: A fine grain over everything. Zoomed in here.

items.name: Vignette
items.label: Dark corners that hold the eye in the middle.

items.name: Tally
items.label: A big number counts up to its target, lands with a pop, and its unit sits beside it.

items.name: Span
items.label: A range counts up, like 2 to 13 m. The two ends land one after the other.

items.name: Three Tiers
items.label: A loud headline, a plain explanation and a quiet detail arrive one after another.

items.name: On Cue
items.label: Words land at the moment they are said. Key words light up in clay on a marker bar.
takes: the words and the second each is said

items.name: Cross Out
items.label: A wrong word is struck out with a clay line, and the right one is set in green.

items.name: Highlighter
items.label: A highlight sweeps behind a word, or draws a line, a box or a loop round it.

items.name: Arrow
items.label: An arrow draws itself from one point to another, straight or curved.

items.name: Calipers
items.label: A measuring line with end ticks and a label, like a distance on a drawing.

items.name: Callout
items.label: A label joined to a point by a thin line. The point can follow something that moves.

items.name: Chain Reaction
items.label: A chain of ideas builds one step at a time, joined by arrows that draw themselves.

items.name: Chapter Rail
items.label: A thin rail along the top. Finished chapters are filled, the current one is lit and named.

items.name: Blueprint
items.label: A tennis or padel court drawn to scale. The lines draw on and the net drops in.

items.name: Metre Flags
items.label: Distance flags pop up along a line on the court, a dot runs along, and one stretch lights up.
takes: where it starts and which way

items.name: Stretch
items.label: A number line that stretches from 0 to 5 m, then 10 m, then 15 m, while one stretch stays lit.
takes: how far it reaches and when

items.name: Streak
items.label: A route draws itself across the court with a bright head and a fading trail.

items.name: Pivot
items.label: The angle of a change of direction: the way in, the way out, and the turn measured.

items.name: Tread
items.label: Foot contacts land one after another along a route, each with a small ring.

items.name: Silhouette
items.label: A simple geometric athlete in side view, moving between five poses.

items.name: Phases
items.label: Poses in a row, named one after another and joined by arrows.

items.name: Push
items.label: An arrow grows from a point. Its length is the size of a force, and it can rise and fall with time.

items.name: Ground Push
items.label: The push of the ground on the athlete: one arrow for the whole push, two for its up part and its forward part.

items.name: Force Curve
items.label: A force-time graph. The axes appear, the curve draws itself, and the area under it fills.

items.name: Slope
items.label: The rate of force development: a line over the steep part of the curve, with its rise and its run.

items.name: Same Peak
items.label: Two curves reach the same peak. One gets there fast, one slow, and at one moment one has far more force.

items.name: Light Up
items.label: The app's own body drawing. Muscles light up one at a time with a name, and the body turns round.

items.name: Push In
items.label: A slow push toward the speaker, like walking in. Use it for emphasis.

items.name: Pull Out
items.label: Pull back out to the wide shot after a close-up.

items.name: Drift
items.label: Slide to a new framing while pushing in a little. A way to make room for a graphic.

items.name: There and Back
items.label: Push in for the point, hold, then return to exactly the wide shot you started on.

items.name: Rev Dial
items.label: A rev counter. The needle climbs in steps and the word in the middle changes: ENGINE, POWER, SPEED.

items.name: Not Equal
items.label: Two ideas, and a not-equal sign that slams down between them.

items.name: Slate
items.label: Crop marks, a running timecode, a section label and progress segments.

items.name: Dot Grid
items.label: A faint grid of dots behind the scene.

items.name: Ghost Numeral
items.label: A huge faint number sitting behind the scene.

items.name: Paper
items.label: Warm paper with a faint grid.

items.name: Ink and Coral
items.label: Black stage, bone type, one coral dot.

items.name: Coral Block
items.label: A full coral screen with black type.

items.name: Primary Paper
items.label: Warm paper with ink, coral and cobalt shapes.

items.name: Cobalt Deep
items.label: Deep blue with pearl pink, lilac and mint highlights.

items.name: Night Spectrum
items.label: Black night with a six-colour spectrum of light.

items.name: Daylight UI
items.label: Bright screen, white cards, cobalt and one coral switch.

items.name: Colour Plates
items.label: Flat plates in ink, cobalt, mint, coral, bone and lilac.

items.name: Signal Colours
items.label: Five colours, five jobs. Bone is normal, clay is the key word, green is the fix, grey is detail, a clay line is a mistake.

items.name: Heavy and Italic
items.label: A very wide black sans with an elegant italic serif.

items.name: Mono Tag
items.label: Small tracked capitals in a coding font, for labels and timecode.

items.name: UI Sans
items.label: A tight, clean sans for interface text and numbers.

items.name: Settle
items.label: Fast arrival, long soft landing.

items.name: Overshoot
items.label: Goes past the mark, then settles back.

items.name: Glide
items.label: Slow, fast, slow.

items.name: Rubber
items.label: Wobbles before it comes to rest.

items.name: Bounce
items.label: Drops and bounces to rest.

items.name: Windup
items.label: Pulls back first, then goes.

items.name: Spring
items.label: Real spring physics: stiffness and damping.

items.name: Stagger
items.label: Start each piece a little after the last.

items.name: Beat Grid
items.label: 128 beats a minute. Eight bars make exactly 15 seconds.

items.name: Downbeat
items.label: Every scene change lands on the first beat of a bar.

items.name: Anticipation
items.label: Land one or two frames early so it feels exactly on the beat.

items.name: Cue Sheet
items.label: The picture writes down every hit it makes. The sound is built from that list, then delayed 12 ms so it never leads.

items.name: Kick
items.label: A deep punch on the beat.

items.name: Clap
items.label: A tight hand clap.

items.name: Snap
items.label: A dry finger snap.

items.name: Hat
items.label: A short closed hi-hat.

items.name: Sizzle
items.label: A long open hi-hat.

items.name: Snare Roll
items.label: A fast roll that builds tension.

items.name: Thump
items.label: A soft low knock under a hit.

items.name: Groove
items.label: A bass line that bounces with the kick.

items.name: Undertow
items.label: A very low hum that slowly swells.

items.name: Wobble
items.label: A low sub that pulses in time.

items.name: Cushion
items.label: A soft chord bed to sit under things.

items.name: Stab
items.label: A short, bright chord hit.

items.name: Staircase
items.label: Single-note stabs, each one higher than the last.

items.name: Last Word
items.label: A big D minor chord that rings out.

items.name: Pluck
items.label: A short plucked note.

items.name: Run
items.label: A fast run of plucks, climbing.

items.name: Bell
items.label: A glassy bell.

items.name: Chime
items.label: A bell chord that rings out.

items.name: Ping
items.label: A single high bell note.

items.name: Knock
items.label: The wooden knock when a letter lands.

items.name: Roll Call
items.label: Six knocks in a row, rising.

items.name: Bubble
items.label: A tiny rising pop for screens.

items.name: Boop
items.label: A small round blip.

items.name: Plink
items.label: Three light plucks for ticking things off.

items.name: Riser
items.label: A rising swoosh that builds to a hit.

items.name: Rush
items.label: Noise rushing in toward a point.

items.name: Whoosh
items.label: A soft air sweep into a hit.

items.name: Swish
items.label: A fast sweep that travels right to left.

items.name: Zip
items.label: A bright sweep, like a line shooting out.

items.name: Inhale
items.label: A quick reverse swell that pulls into the next scene.

items.name: Scanner
items.label: A sci-fi sweep that travels left to right.

items.name: Glassline
items.label: A glassy tone that climbs while something draws.

items.name: Slide
items.label: A smooth tone that follows a slider.

items.name: Boom
items.label: A deep, low explosion.

items.name: Crash
items.label: A bright cymbal splash.

items.name: Blast
items.label: A burst that closes down fast.

items.name: Lub-Dub
items.label: Two soft thumps, like a pulse.

items.name: Drop
items.label: Silence, then kick, boom and crash together.

items.name: Click
items.label: A tactile switch click.

items.name: Ticks
items.label: Fast tiny ticks, like a ruler printing.

items.name: Clatter
items.label: Eight fast ticks, like blinds.

items.name: Pixels
items.label: Six tiny digital beeps.

items.name: Peep
items.label: A short rising blip.

items.name: Stutter
items.label: A broken digital stutter.

items.name: Flup
items.label: A quick down-bend, like a card flipping.

items.name: Footsteps
items.label: Four sneaker steps on a hard court, two with a squeak.

items.name: Ball Hit
items.label: A racket hitting a tennis ball, first hard, then soft.

items.name: Ball Bounce
items.label: A ball bouncing three times, each bounce lower and quicker.

items.name: Clank
items.label: A weight plate touching a barbell, twice, the second one lighter.

items.name: Thud Drop
items.label: A heavy plate dropped on a rubber floor.

items.name: Notify
items.label: A soft pair of bell notes for something new that appeared.

items.name: Swipe
items.label: A quick airy sweep for a graphic that slides on.

items.name: Vacuum
items.label: A tiny silence right before a big hit, so the hit lands harder. Without, then with.

items.name: Pump
items.label: Chords and bass duck on every kick.

items.name: Space
items.label: Reverb: a room that makes sounds ring. Dry first, then wet.

items.name: Duck
items.label: The music lowers itself while a voice speaks, first without, then with.
